newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran hangs four men for murder, rape.
newsitem.headline: Iran hangs four men for murder, rape.

text.p: Iran on Wednesday executed three convicted murderers and a rapist, a newspaper reported.
The evening Kayhan said the three murderers were hanged at dawn in a Tehran prison after Iran's Supreme Court upheld their death sentences in separate cases.
It named the men as Saeid Torkaman, Reza Akhlaqi and Akbar Daqiq-Moshtari.

Ali Karimi was hanged along with the others for raping, battering and robbing several women whom he had picked up in his car together with an accomplice who is still sought by police, the newspaper added.
